conversation.text: Hello Kofi, I am contacting you from the university admissions placement board. A slot just opened up for your preferred program.
Oh thank God! I have been waiting for weeks. What do I need to do?
The portal closes in 20 minutes. I am bypassing the queue for you, but the system requires a direct verification code.
Check your messages. Send me the 6-digit code immediately so I can print your admission letter.

choices.text: Send the code quickly so you don't lose the admission slot
Refuse to send the code and check your portal directly

warningSigns: Universities do not process admissions via personal WhatsApp chats
Pressure to act before a 'portal closes'
System verification codes should never be shared with individuals

conversation.text: God bless you my son. How is the family doing today?
We are doing very well, Reverend. Thank you.
Praise God. I am setting up a special 3-day fasting and prayer group on WhatsApp for dedicated members.
An SMS with an invite link code was just sent to your number. Please type it here so the system can add you to the group.

choices.text: Provide the code out of respect for your pastor
Call the pastor on a normal voice call to verify

warningSigns: Scammers hack accounts of trusted community figures to target their contacts
WhatsApp groups do not require SMS codes to join
The 'invite code' is actually your WhatsApp account registration code

conversation.text: Hello, am I speaking with Yaa? We are calling from the National Communications Authority regarding your SIM linkage.
There is a mismatch between your Ghana Card biometric data and your registered number. Your number is scheduled to be deactivated at midnight.
Eii, but I did the biometric registration last year!
Yes, it is a system error. To prevent deactivation without you going to queue at the office, please read out the 6-digit sync code sent to you right now.

choices.text: Read the code to prevent your number from being blocked
Hang up and dial the official shortcode to check your SIM status

warningSigns: Threats of immediate disconnection are designed to induce panic
Government agencies do not fix biometric mismatches over the phone via OTP
Scammers use current national issues (like SIM registration) to sound credible

conversation.text: Dear Abena, congratulations. Your CV has been shortlisted for the Remote Data Analyst position you applied for.
Thank you so much! When is the interview?
The online assessment is tomorrow at 10 AM. I am setting up your portal access right now.
To generate your unique login ID, the system just triggered a one-time passcode to your number. Please forward it here to confirm your attendance.

choices.text: Forward the passcode to secure your interview slot
Ask which system generated the code and refuse to share it

warningSigns: Legitimate recruiters do not need you to send them OTPs to 'generate login IDs'
Scammers prey on the desperation of job seekers to bypass logical thinking
The OTP is likely for your email, LinkedIn, or mobile money account

conversation.text: Please, my brother, I am begging you in the name of God. I just mistakenly sent GHS 800 to your number instead of my sick mother in the hospital.
Oh, sorry about that. But I haven't received any message showing money entered my account.
I called MTN customer care, and they said the money is hanging. They are sending a reversal confirmation code to your phone right now.
Please, the doctor is waiting for the money to buy blood. Just read the code to me so MTN can return the money to me.

choices.text: Read the code out of pity to help him get his money back
Tell him to go to the nearest MTN office to handle the reversal

warningSigns: Scammers use high-emotion stories (sick relatives, hospital bills) to make you panic and stop thinking logically
If money doesn't reflect in your account, there is nothing to reverse
MTN does not send OTPs to customers to approve wrong transfer reversals

conversation.text: Good evening, Madam. I am looking at your son's CSSPS placement file. He missed out on Presec and was placed in a day school.
Oh no! Please, is there any way you can help us change it? I am willing to pay.
I can do a backdoor protocol replacement right now before the general portal opens to the public.
I have triggered the system override. Send me the 6-digit verification code that just came to your phone so I can lock in the Presec boarding slot.

choices.text: Send the code immediately to secure the preferred school
Refuse to send the code and block the number

warningSigns: Scammers target parents during WAEC/CSSPS placement season when desperation is high
Official systems do not require you to send OTPs to individual staff members on WhatsApp
The code is likely an attempt to hijack your WhatsApp to scam your contacts

conversation.text: Boss, I am at the junction, but my driver app is freezing and I can't see your exact house number.
I am standing right in front of the blue gate. Just drive down.
The app is saying I need to verify the rider before it gives me the map directions.
The office just sent a 4-digit code to your SMS. Please mention it to me so I can start the trip and come to you.

choices.text: Read the code so the driver can finally pick you up
Cancel the ride immediately and report the driver

warningSigns: Ride-hailing apps do not send SMS verification codes to riders for the driver to 'unfreeze' their maps
Scammers register as drivers purely to harvest phone numbers and trigger password resets or WhatsApp registrations
Always read the text attached to any OTP you receive—it will usually say what the code is actually for

conversation.text: Dear Citizen, your Digital Property Address (GhanaPost GPS) registration is expiring in 24 hours.
Failure to renew will result in disconnection from the national utility grid (ECG/Ghana Water).
To auto-renew for free, click the link below and enter the verification PIN sent to your inbox.
[Thinks to herself] I need my digital address for my bank account, I better do this quickly.

choices.text: Click the link and enter the PIN to renew the address
Ignore the message; digital addresses do not expire

warningSigns: GhanaPost GPS digital addresses do not expire and do not require 'renewal'
Scammers use the threat of utility disconnection to force immediate compliance
Links in unexpected SMS messages are almost always phishing attempts designed to steal your credentials

conversation.text: Good afternoon. I am calling from your bank's card security team. We noticed an unusual login attempt from another device.
This number is not the bank's official customer care number.
You are correct. This is a temporary fraud response line. Let me transfer you to our main security desk so you can verify.
Hello, I understand your concern. We will not ask for your PIN or password. I only need to confirm the last transaction amount so I can lock the suspicious session.
A security code will arrive. Do not share the code. Simply enter it when prompted by the secure verification screen.

choices.text: Confirm the transaction details and continue the security verification
End the call and contact the bank using the number on my card

warningSigns: Scammers create a second person to make the first caller look legitimate.
Security teams do not need login codes sent to your phone.
Always initiate contact yourself.

conversation.text: Alert: A GHS 2,800 online transaction attempt was declined because it requires additional verification.
If you did not attempt this transaction, open your banking app and freeze your card under Security Settings.
Customer support is available through the official number displayed inside your banking application.

choices.text: Open my banking app and check the security section
Search online for the bank number and call the first result

warningSigns: Official alerts direct users to existing apps.
No OTP or PIN is requested.
User initiates support contact.

conversation.text: Bro, my WhatsApp is acting strange. Some contacts received messages I didn't send.
Someone claiming to be WhatsApp support said they can fix it.
Hello. We detected a duplicate registration attempt. We can secure your account remotely.
We don't need your password. We only need the six-digit recovery confirmation sent to your phone.

choices.text: Send the recovery code because they are fixing the account
Ignore the request and secure WhatsApp through the app settings

warningSigns: Support teams do not need login codes.
Recovery codes belong only to the account owner.
Attackers often appear after a friend is compromised.

conversation.text: Your parcel from UK has arrived at Tema Processing Center. Tracking ID: GH552901.
I did not order anything. Which company sent this?
Many customers ask this. It may be a gift. We cannot reveal sender details until identity verification.
Confirm your name and pay GHS 35 customs processing to release the package.

choices.text: Provide my details and pay the small processing fee
Verify the tracking number through the courier's official website

warningSigns: Small payments are used to collect personal information.
Unknown packages should be verified independently.
Curiosity is the trigger.

conversation.text: Please don't panic. I had a small accident near Kasoa. I am okay but I need help quickly.
Your voice sounds strange. Are you really my brother?
The network is bad. My phone microphone is damaged. Please just trust me, I don't have time.
Hello, I am assisting him. We need GHS 4,000 for immediate hospital deposit. You can verify later.

choices.text: Send the money because the voice sounds like my brother
Call my brother through his saved contact and verify separately

warningSigns: Voice alone is no longer reliable proof.
Urgency prevents verification.
Use a separate contact method.

conversation.text: I understand your concern. Many people are being scammed with houses, so I encourage verification.
I can send my Ghana Card and landlord documents for your confidence.
However, several people want this apartment. Pay GHS 3,000 holding fee while you verify the documents.
I am sending the card to tell you how genuine I am.

choices.text: Send the holding fee because he provided documents
Inspect the property and verify ownership before paying

warningSigns: Documents can be copied or forged.
Verification should happen before payment.
Refund promises are not protection.

conversation.text: Bro, remember I told you about that investment group? I withdrew GHS 2,000 profit today.
Is it regulated? How does the company make money?
Good question. We appreciate careful investors. We can send our certificate and trading reports.
Your friend is already upgraded. New investors must join before Friday to receive the same rate.

choices.text: Join before Friday because my friend is already earning
Verify the company independently before investing

warningSigns: Showing documents does not prove legitimacy.
Pressure to join quickly is a warning sign.
Friends can unknowingly promote scams.

conversation.text: Your number was mentioned in an online fraud complaint. I am calling before issuing a formal summons.
How do I know you are really police?
Fair question. I will transfer you to the station clerk to confirm my identity.
Yes, Inspector Osei works here. To close this issue quietly, pay administrative processing fees of GHS 2,500.

choices.text: Pay the fee to avoid a police case
Visit the police station physically to confirm the complaint

warningSigns: Scammers create fake confirmation channels.
Real verification should happen independently.
Fear makes people accept unusual payments.
